name: Commerce Action on NSTC Operations and Natcast Agreement
known_limitations: The release establishes Commerce's decision to transfer NSTC operational responsibility to NIST and its position that the prior up-to-$7.4-billion Natcast agreement was invalid. It does not provide a recipient-by-recipient disposition of every NAPMP award, facility commitment, subcontract, payment, or continuing activity.
automation_notes: Reconcile the Commerce action against each NAPMP and NSTC award, facility agreement, payment, operator, procurement, and milestone before treating the January 2025 funding stack as current.
notes: Phase 55N program-governance record. Treat the source's legal characterization as Commerce's official position and avoid extending it to individual awards without a specific disposition record.
